title: Precision Selection, Transform, Snapping, Vector Geometry, Paths & Edit History
objective: Implement the map-bounded object/vector editing kernel over the MCS-01 cartography document foundation: precision selection and grouping, transforms and alignment, snapping/guides, vector/path editing and reversible creator history while keeping canonical owner history and live Scene/runtime state outside MCS authority.

scope.purpose: Provide the bounded MCS object/vector editing kernel over MCS-01 authoring identities without becoming canonical World, Scene, spatial or owner-history authority.
scope.completion_gate: Representative MCS document objects can be selected, transformed, snapped and vector/path-edited deterministically with reversible creator history while canonical owner history, live Scene placement and owner-domain truth remain unchanged.

selection_boundaries: MCS-01 remains the cartography workspace/document/layer/object identity foundation; MCS-03 edits MCS authoring projections only.
MAI retains map asset/package/projection authority; ISE/Scene/Tabletop retain live canvas/placement authority; SSA/World retain semantic spatial truth.
Snapping receipts and geometry helpers remain authoring/presentation evidence or proposals and never silently create canonical spatial/world truth.
Reversible creator history uses deterministic before/after checksums and inverse restore-authoring-snapshot receipts while canonical owner history remains separate and unmodified.

ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 and MCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json were reconsulted after exact-tree MCS-03 publication. MCS-03 creates no rotation detour; MCS-05 is the next surviving MCS tranche and is selected_not_started only.
MCS-07, PCA-16, MCCS, MRCS, MSAS, MNCS, SMB-08 and downstream work remain unauthorized until separately selected/governed-started.

red.failure_signature: All four focused acceptance cases failed expected-null-not-to-be-null because the authorized MCS-03 production module was intentionally absent.

green_diagnostic.failure_signature: tools/verify_mcs_03.py was intentionally absent before proof surfaces were added.

next_action: MCS-03 is closed. MCS-05 is selected_not_started after fresh ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH and MCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.

stop_reason.evidence: MCS-03 exact-head validation passed on Linux and Windows with deterministic comparison; PR 541 published the exact validated tree; the application lease was released; fresh DAG/backlog reconciliation keeps MCS-05 as the next surviving MCS tranche; atomic AIOC closeout is represented by this candidate.
